mapper.select: select count(assets.uid) from ( select ai.id as asset_id, ai.uid, ai.asset_dept_uid, ai.clinical_dept_uid, ai.status as asset_status, ai.name as asset_name, ai.depart_num as asset_num, ai.shared_asset_type, ai.tenant_uid as asset_tenant_uid, ai.institution_uid as asset_institution_uid, ai.hospital_uid as asset_hospital_uid, ai.site_uid as asset_site_uid, ai.financing_num, ai.qr_code, ai.serial_num, ai.manufacture, oi.name as lease_org_name, oi.name_py_code as org_name_py_code, sat.swap_name as swap_name, sard.charging_type as req_charging_type, sard.unit_price as req_unit_price, sard.charging_begin_time, sard.charging_end_time from asset_info ai left join shared_asset_type sat on ai.shared_asset_type = sat.id left join org_info oi on ai.asset_dept_uid=oi.uid left join (select * from shared_asset_req_detail where charging_end_time is null or charging_end_time > now()) sard on ai.uid=sard.asset_info_id ) assets ${ew.sqlSegment}

select * from ( select ai.id as asset_id, ai.uid, ai.asset_dept_uid, ai.clinical_dept_uid, ai.status as asset_status, ai.name as asset_name, ai.depart_num as asset_num, ai.shared_asset_type, ai.tenant_uid as asset_tenant_uid, ai.institution_uid as asset_institution_uid, ai.hospital_uid as asset_hospital_uid, ai.site_uid as asset_site_uid, ai.financing_num, ai.qr_code, ai.serial_num, ai.manufacture, oi.name as lease_org_name, oi.name_py_code as org_name_py_code, sat.id as sat_id, sat.swap_name as swap_name, sat.unit_price as asset_unit_price, sat.charging_type as asset_charging_type, sat.starting_duration as asset_starting_duration, sat.starting_price as asset_starting_price, sard.id as sard_id, sard.charging_begin_time, sard.charging_end_time, sard.charging_type as req_charging_type, sard.unit_price as req_unit_price, sard.borrow_id, sard.return_id from asset_info ai left join shared_asset_type sat on ai.shared_asset_type = sat.id left join org_info oi on ai.asset_dept_uid=oi.uid left join (select * from shared_asset_req_detail where charging_end_time is null or charging_end_time > now()) sard on ai.uid=sard.asset_info_id ) assets ${ew.sqlSegment}
